description: prConcurrentLimit was 5. Three PRs stuck since 2026-05-20 — all checks green, automerge on, unmergeable because a 3.5-month-old lockfile branch conflicts — held 3 of those 5 slots, so the family's own bumps stayed permanently rate-limited and 18 inter-package pins drifted. @orangecheck/agent-core reached 1.1.0 while six adapters still pinned ^0.1.0 or ^0.3.0, and a caret on a 0.x version locks the MINOR, so those ranges could never have reached it even unblocked.

packageRules.description: Disabled by default — this Renovate config is scoped to the @orangecheck/* family ONLY. Third-party deps (next, react, tailwind, etc.) are NOT auto-tracked here; bump them by hand when you choose to. EVERY update type is listed deliberately: this rule originally named only patch/minor/major, so lockFileMaintenance slipped past it and opened third-party PRs (jose, ws) that no later rule then enabled for automerge — they sat open for 3.5 months holding concurrency slots.

Auto-merge @orangecheck/* patch + minor — bundled into one PR per consumer, 1-day stability window so a yanked publish never reaches a consumer. automergeType is 'pr', not 'branch': every consumer's ci.yml triggers on pull_request, so a bare branch push runs no type-check, lint, or test at all. Branch mode merged dependency bumps that CI had never seen.
Human-review @orangecheck/* major bumps — these change wire shape.
